limitations: The Might / Guard / Wisdom hooks in CombatService and ProgressionService are checked statically (those modules are not run here); the bag's Drink button and a tonic quick slot are client work (게임성 개발 4 / 1); the market (게임성 개발 2) is where non-alchemists will buy them.
